name: IBM
look: Carbon design system chrome — square corners everywhere, weight-300 display, one blue, and a charcoal footer as the only dark surface.

hero.title: Enterprise technology that survives an audit
hero.sub: Hybrid cloud, data platforms and AI governance built for organisations where a wrong answer has a regulator attached to it.

features.title: Built for the constrained enterprise
features.sub: The requirements that make consumer-grade tooling unusable are the starting point here.

items.title: Hybrid cloud
items.body: Workloads that run on-premise, in your cloud, or both, under one control plane.

items.title: AI governance
items.body: Model lineage, drift monitoring and documented decisions, because someone will ask.

items.title: Data platform
items.body: Catalogued, governed data with lineage from source to dashboard.

items.title: Confidential computing
items.body: Data encrypted in use, so even the operator cannot read it.

items.title: Industry models
items.body: Pre-built for banking, healthcare and insurance regulatory shapes.

items.title: Consulting
items.body: People who have done the migration before, available to do yours.

showcases.title: Governance is not a feature you add later
showcases.body: Model lineage, approval workflow and drift monitoring are part of the platform rather than a compliance layer bolted on afterwards. When a regulator asks how a decision was made, the answer is a report rather than a project.
points: Lineage from training data to decision

showcases.title: People who have done it before
showcases.body: Platform work fails on the organisational parts more often than the technical ones. Our consulting practice has run these migrations in the same industries and under the same constraints.

testimonial.quote: The audit took four days instead of six weeks. Every model decision had lineage attached, which is the only reason that was possible.

notes: The marketing chrome is the design system. Buttons are square, inputs are square with a bottom rule, and corners stay at 0px throughout.
Light-weight display type — weight 300 at 42–76px — is the typographic signature. Bolding it makes it a different brand.
One accent blue carries every link, primary CTA and banner. There is no second brand colour.
White canvas, light grey and charcoal cover about 95% of surfaces.
The footer inverts to charcoal and is the only dark surface above the page break.
